progression.narrative: The performance opens on As4 and dwells most on Ab in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:15.5) introduces Db, centred on Db. Phrase 3 (0:28.0) introduces Ds, centred on Db. Phrase 5 (1:02.7) introduces Ab, centred on Db. The line peaks at Ds5 (599.9 Hz) at 0:37.2. It closes on the tonic (Ab4 → B3 → Ds4 → Ab3 → Db4 → Ab3).
